# Rollback errors

Thrown as `RollbackError` (`code: "rollback"`). Each entry is an identifier (`error.id`), the message as the error
states it (`{name}` stands for a value it names), and what to do about it: the text
`useFullErrorMessages(messages)` and `explain(error)` add. See [Errors](/reference/errors).

::: v-pre

## `rollback.batchFailed` {#rollback-batchfailed}

> The batch failed at its step "&#123;step&#125;" and was rolled back; error.reason holds &#123; step, error, completed &#125;.

Call repo.transaction(batch) instead of transactionOrThrow() to get it back as a failed Result.

## `rollback.called` {#rollback-called}

> The transaction was rolled back: tx.rollback(reason) was called, and the reason is error.reason.

Call repo.transaction() instead of transactionOrThrow() to get the reason back as a failed Result.

## `rollback.statementFailed` {#rollback-statementfailed}

> The transaction was rolled back because a statement in it failed and the callback returned anyway (the statement's error is error.reason).

Let the error propagate, or run the statement that may fail in a nested tx.transaction().

:::
